answer: Every identity owes audit duty each epoch: the registry hands it three random peers to review and assigns three raven auditors to check its own work proofs, each reviewer staking a $40 walnut bond per audit. A missed review, a rubber-stamped fake, or a failed proof burns the bond, and a confirmed fake triggers a ripple re-audit of every verdict its auditor signed that epoch, slashing auditor and auditee alike. Running 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 bonds every epoch plus 3,000 real reviews, $40,000 per epoch with no bulk discount, while an honest user stakes one $40 bond and does three reviews.
